description: Fork of exp303 (current SOTA 1.6509 @ 8K). Single trade: extend the layer-0/1 out_proj tph=2048 boost to layers 2,3 as well. out_tph_per_layer [2048,2048,1024,1024,1024,1024] -> [2048,2048,2048,2048,1024,1024]. +33 M params (~635 M total). Tests whether the heavy-early scheme should reach deeper into the network. exp306 showed uniform-1024 trails exp303 by ~+0.011 bpb mid-run (layer 0-1 boost is worth ~+0.007 bpb); this asks whether layer 2-3 boost is also worth it or just inert weight.
